name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: A Gmail mailbox reached over IMAP and SMTP — signed in with Google, or with an app password.
needed_for: Reads and sends mail from your Gmail mailbox.
justification: A Gmail data source reads the mailbox over IMAP and sends over SMTP as you. Google accepts either a Google sign-in that grants mail access or an app password for that, never the account password.

GMAIL_GOOGLE.label: Sign in with Google
GMAIL_GOOGLE.hint: Grants Flowpad access to this mailbox through your Google account. Nothing to copy.

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.label: App password
GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.hint: Requires 2-Step Verification on the Google account. A Workspace admin can disable app passwords entirely.
